fact: The HAPDP, chaired by Mme Sanadi Tchimaden Hadatan, handed its 2021 activity report to the Prime Minister on 2 June 2022, reporting 18 processing authorisations, 16 transfer authorisations and 2 opinions granted in sessions.
title: Protection des données à caractère personnel : La HAPDP remet son Rapport de l'année 2021 au Premier ministre
